recent.text: On November 17, 2013, Ben Scrivens became the 10th goaltender in @LAKings' history to record back-to-back shutouts when he shut out the Rangers at Madison Square Garden. recent.text: On November 17, 1983, the @LAKings acquired defenseman Mike McEwen from the New York Islanders for a fourth round draft pick.
